unit.why: A description of the Maggid of Kozienice's frail body and ecstatic prayer habits, culminating in an anecdote of him leaping onto a wagon on the way to a circumcision meal.

stories.start_quote: בספר דברים ערבים וזה"ל. ידוע לרבים
stories.end_quote: ורקד על העגלה הוא בעצמו כאיש גבור חיל
stories.summary_en: The Maggid of Kozienice, frail as dry wood and always lying sick in bed, became strong in prayer, dancing with the Torah scroll and candles. Invited to a circumcision feast, he refused help mounting the wagon, saying he draws strength from God, and leapt onto it himself.
